review.basis: Names/products required by unchanged standard Premise market equations; same-unit one-for-one links to the exact native suppliers.
limitations: Native Swiss electricity infrastructure and European SF6 represent the standard CH/CA-QC/RoW/RER supplier locations as explicit geographic screening proxies. Market-construction quantities remain Premise assumptions; no technology or inventory equivalence is claimed.

The European SF6 factory process proxies a delivered-material market: delivery/packaging boundaries, geography and vintage may differ, and missing delivery burdens are unquantified. No freight or packaging inventory is invented.
